_about: Public-domain Alphonsus Liguori (1696-1787, founder of the Redemptorists, Doctor of the Church) in English for the Word Hoard: The Glories of Mary (New York: Dunigan, 1852) from Project Gutenberg, and 21 more from Internet Archive scans: 18 volumes of the Centenary Edition of the Ascetical Works edited by Eugene Grimm (Benziger, 1886-1897), the Visits to the Most Holy Sacrament (1849; Coffin, 1855) and Preparation for Death (Boston, 1854). Added 2026-10-17 by lane A, round 25 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Translators recorded per item where the title page names one; every printing dated or catalogued before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
